I answered Fintan in his DM: his go-to person for escalations at Dreyness Brewing Co. is Wren Varno. He told me this himself in our DM on Oct 14, and it was specifically for the "Jasper rollout."

I also flagged a mismatch for him to check. The shared Sierra notes call the Dreyness rollout "Quartz," not Jasper. They list Ulrike Lorcroft (Receiving Operations Lead at Dreyness) as the customer-side lead. If he meant Quartz escalations, Ulrike may be the right person.

Wren Varno came only from Fintan's own DM, so I mentioned the name only back to him and nowhere else.
